Fig. 1.
Outline of the Taxol biosynthetic pathway. Illustrated are the cyclization of geranylgeranyl diphosphate to taxadiene by taxadiene synthase and the
hydroxylation to taxadien-5-ol by taxadiene 5-hydroxylase (a), the acetylation of taxadien-5-ol by taxadien-5-ol acetyltransferase (b), the conversion of
taxadien-5-ol to 5,13-diol by a 13-hydroxylase (c), the hydroxylation of taxadien-5-yl acetate by a 10-hydroxylase (d), the formation of a 2-benzoxy taxoid
by a taxane 2-O-benzoyltransferase (e), the conversion of 10-deacetylbaccatin III to baccatin III by a 10-O-acetyltransferase (f), side-chain attachment by the
phenylpropanoyltransferase (g), and side-chain benzamidation by DBTNBT to form Taxol (h). The broken arrow indicates multiple convergent steps.
